title: Ask My Aunt's Ledger  (问问我姑妈的账本)

segments.t: 周六傍晚时分，在前台处，汉娜和伊夫林小姐把手写乐谱放到亚瑟面前的柜台灯下。先听一遍完整的对话场景。
Arthur, look what was hiding inside the upright piano in Room Nine!
Handwritten music? Let me pull my glasses down... wait a second!
Do you know who wrote 'Courtyard Waltz' thirty years ago, Arthur?
Look at those round capital letters. That is my aunt's handwriting!
Your aunt played the piano and ran the Friday tea room?!
She baked cakes in the morning and wrote little songs at night!
Why did she stop halfway through page two in May thirty years ago?
Her old green guest book from that spring is still in the attic chest!
Wait, the front desk telephone is blinking with a recorded voice message.
Press play, Hannah! Who calls on Saturday evening?!
It is the city heritage office... they moved our cafe inspection to Wednesday at three!
Wednesday at three?! That gives us three days instead of six!
现在我们来逐句详细讲解。
Arthur, look what was hiding inside the upright piano in Room Nine!
“亚瑟，快看九号房那架立式钢琴里面藏着什么！”这句话的过去进行时把藏起来的物品写得生动鲜活，体现在
what was hiding
中；而 upright piano 指的是靠墙的立式钢琴，与三角钢琴相对。
Handwritten music? Let me pull my glasses down... wait a second!
“手写的乐谱？让我把眼镜拉下来……等一下！”因为亚瑟总是把眼镜架在额头上，所以他得用
pull my glasses down...
把眼镜拉到眼前，同时把宾语放在 pull 和 down 中间。
Do you know who wrote 'Courtyard Waltz' thirty years ago, Arthur?
“亚瑟，你知道三十年前是谁写了《庭院圆舞曲》吗？”嵌套在 Do you know 里面时，这个间接问句
who wrote
保持正常的陈述句语序。
Look at those round capital letters. That is my aunt's handwriting!
“看那些圆润的大写字母。那是我姑妈的字迹！”大写字母叫做
capital letters.
，而 handwriting 则指个人独特的手写笔迹。
Your aunt played the piano and ran the Friday tea room?!
“你姑妈以前不仅弹钢琴，还经营周五的茶室！？”动词 run 除了“跑”之外，还有“经营、管理（生意）”的意思，因此它的不规则过去式用在
ran the Friday tea room?!
中，在这里和 played the piano 并列搭配。
She baked cakes in the morning and wrote little songs at night!
“她早上烤蛋糕，晚上写些小曲子！”注意一天中不同时段前面介词的变化：
in the morning
用 in 并带有定冠词，而句末的 at night 则用 at 且不加冠词。
Why did she stop halfway through page two in May thirty years ago?
“为什么她在三十年前的五月写到第二页一半就停了？”想要表达某件事进行到一页、一本书或一项任务的半途，可以用
halfway through page two
，也就是把表示“半途”的 halfway 和 through 连在一起。
Her old green guest book from that spring is still in the attic chest!
“她那年春天用的旧绿色宾客登记簿还在阁楼的箱子里！”供访客签名并记录住宿信息的簿子叫做
guest book
，这里就存放在 the attic chest（阁楼的木箱）里。
Wait, the front desk telephone is blinking with a recorded voice message.
“等等，前台的电话正闪烁着提示，有一条语音留言。”用来提示有留言的一闪一灭小红灯，可以用
is blinking
来描述，blink 这个词也正是我们用来表示“眨眼”的动词。
Press play, Hannah! Who calls on Saturday evening?!
“汉娜，按播放键！周六下午会是谁打来的！？”在任何语音信箱或音频播放器上，只要说
Press play,
就可以了，play 前面不需要加冠词。
It is the city heritage office... they moved our cafe inspection to Wednesday at three!
“是市政遗产保护办公室……他们把我们咖啡馆的检查提前到周三三点了！”要把日程上的预约或活动改期，用动词 move 搭配 to 就可以了：
moved our cafe inspection to Wednesday
而 heritage 指城市的历史遗产。
Wednesday at three?! That gives us three days instead of six!
“周三三点！？这样我们就只剩三天而不是六天了！”为了对比他们原本预期的时间和实际拥有的时间，这里用到了
instead of six!
为下一集留下了悬念。让我们最后再连贯地听一遍整场戏。
Arthur, look what was hiding inside the upright piano in Room Nine!
Handwritten music? Let me pull my glasses down... wait a second!
Do you know who wrote 'Courtyard Waltz' thirty years ago, Arthur?
Look at those round capital letters. That is my aunt's handwriting!
Your aunt played the piano and ran the Friday tea room?!
She baked cakes in the morning and wrote little songs at night!
Why did she stop halfway through page two in May thirty years ago?
Her old green guest book from that spring is still in the attic chest!
Wait, the front desk telephone is blinking with a recorded voice message.
Press play, Hannah! Who calls on Saturday evening?!
It is the city heritage office... they moved our cafe inspection to Wednesday at three!
Wednesday at three?! That gives us three days instead of six!
这首未完成的圆舞曲正是亚瑟姑妈的亲笔手稿，而市政检查也刚刚从周五提前到了周三三点！恭喜你：你已经完成了第二集。我们很快在第三集见！
Have a good evening!
